# Mathavan Traders

> A bilingual Tamil and English Deepavali fireworks catalogue and WhatsApp enquiry service in Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu. This is not an e-commerce website.

## Public pages
- [Fireworks catalogue](https://festival-catalog.lovable.app/): 2026 product list, prices, categories, contact details, and WhatsApp enquiry.
- [Fireworks FAQ](https://festival-catalog.lovable.app/faq): Answers about Sivakasi, Deepavali fireworks, safety, enquiries, and delivery.
